title: A retreat project begins and ends on one present-threat test and completes when its threat is gone
summary: COMBAT_RETREAT adopted only under present_threat_to; completes THREAT_CLEARED when the threat is gone and the subject reached its destination or stayed clear 200 ticks (cleared_since); tactical flight uses the same test (option A). Measured on F3: no Tier 1, 21 of 21 Tier 2 victims FAIL, never-threatened adoptions 1101 to 0.
